newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish shares seen up, awaits KGHM debut Thursday.
newsitem.headline: Polish shares seen up, awaits KGHM debut Thursday.

text.p: The Polish bourse was expected to rise for the fifth session running after the strong buying after price-fixing that followed Tuesday's mixed session.

Analysts said the market was awaiting the Thursday debut of copper giant KGHM Polska Miedz to see if the bourse could achieve significant growth after digesting large public offers of KGHM and Bank Handlowy.
The domestic-investor tranche of KGHM's offering last week was 62-percent oversubscribed, the institutional tranche 22-percent oversubscribed.
